verdict.root_cause: Two minutes before onset, platform-automation set QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR on shippingservice to http://quoteservice-gone:8090, an address that names a host which is not a live quote backend [tr_df91c2ae7515]. shippingservice's GetQuote can therefore not be satisfied, and checkoutservice's client span for hipstershop.ShippingService/GetQuote is the sole errored child in 10 of 11 shown failing checkout traces, propagating up through PlaceOrder to the frontend HTTP root [tr_00cb71419679]. checkoutservice has no change records in 24 hours [tr_233bf12317e1] and its logs show orders starting but never reaching the payment/email/message-write lines, i.e. stalling inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart [tr_d98de2cef145]. The wrong address value is itself the failure, so the fix is reverting that environment variable to its pre-11:35 value.
verdict.reasoning: Traces localise the error carrier to the checkoutservice->ShippingService/GetQuote client span and explicitly clear cart/redis, productcatalog, currency, payment and email [tr_00cb71419679]. checkoutservice logs show the order flow truncating exactly at the shipping-quote step with no panics, credential errors, or loss of inbound traffic [tr_d98de2cef145], and checkoutservice has no deploy, flag, image or rollback events at all [tr_233bf12317e1]. The only onset-proximate act found anywhere is the QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR edit ~2 minutes before the 11:38 alert, an identical value having been applied and reverted earlier the same morning [tr_df91c2ae7515]. It is bad_config rather than dependency_latency because failing roots are 8-11ms with the shipping hop adding only ~3ms and no long stall [tr_00cb71419679] - a hard error, not a wait. Confidence is medium: the shippingservice server span is not itself flagged ERROR [tr_00cb71419679] and shipping's error ratio has no samples in either window [tr_137f717fbf1e], so the runtime effect of the value was never directly observed.
open_questions: No shipping log line, metric or span directly records a failure reaching quoteservice-gone; the change log records the edit, not its effect [tr_df91c2ae7515], and the shipping server span carries no ERROR flag [tr_00cb71419679].
The shippingservice log query covered 2026-09-16 11:38-17:38, roughly a day before onset, so its healthy-service findings and exonerations [tr_e2347fd30d25] do not describe the incident window.

checkoutservice error ratio shows no change point near 11:38 and an already-elevated baseline [tr_c992ab65bf62]; onset timing rests on the alert and change record. Trace coverage is 11 of 40, and one failing trace has no shipping span at all [tr_00cb71419679].

alternatives.root_cause: The quote backend behind shippingservice became slow and GetQuote calls fail on client deadline while waiting.
alternatives.why_not: Failing traces total 8-11ms with only ~3ms in the shipping hop and no long stall [tr_00cb71419679], which is a hard error rather than a wait; a deadline failure would pin the client span near a timeout.

alternatives.root_cause: Checkout failures are a pre-existing intermittent condition in checkoutservice that merely coincides with the shipping config edit.
alternatives.why_not: Admissible given the elevated baseline and absent change point [tr_c992ab65bf62], but it does not explain why errors concentrate on the GetQuote client span while all other dependencies are clean [tr_00cb71419679], nor the 2-minute proximity of the address edit [tr_df91c2ae7515].

proposal.expected_effect: After restoring shippingservice's pre-11:35 environment, newly sampled checkout traces should stop showing the checkoutservice client span for hipstershop.ShippingService/GetQuote flagged ERROR, and with it the ERROR propagation to PlaceOrder and the frontend HTTP root [tr_00cb71419679]. Second, independent check: checkoutservice logs should resume the four-line per-order sequence (order start, payment, confirmation email, message-write) instead of stopping at order-start [tr_d98de2cef145]. shippingservice's own error-ratio series has no samples in any window, so it cannot confirm anything.
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if, five minutes on, GetQuote client spans still carry ERROR or checkout orders still stall after the order-start line. Note the causal link is timing-only: nothing records a call actually failing against quoteservice-gone, and the shipping server span carries no ERROR flag [tr_df91c2ae7515][tr_00cb71419679]. Also the recorded prior value is 'None' (unset), so the revert removes the variable rather than setting a known-good host. One failing trace has no shipping span at all, so a residue of failures is expected and is not evidence either way.
proposal.risk: If the address is not the mechanism, this removes a quote backend shipping may be using successfully - its server spans are unflagged and return in 2.1-2.8ms - replacing a partial failure with a new one. The recreate alone drops in-flight GetQuote and ShipOrder calls. Reversible only via a second recreate.
proposal.blast_radius: shippingservice is recreated; checkoutservice, its direct caller, sees connection resets that propagate to frontend and to loadgenerator's checkout traffic. Any host QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR previously named sees traffic move.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical alert on checkoutservice with loadgenerator following shortly, indicating real user-facing order flow failure rather than a lone synthetic or warning-level signal. No open incidents to attribute it to, and the many unmeasured downstream dependencies leave the cause genuinely open.
